Thanks for installing Clock Seconds!

1. Activate: in LSPosed, enable this module and check “SystemUI”, then restart SystemUI.
2. Show/hide seconds: tap the status-bar time (top left) to toggle. If it conflicts with pulling down the shade, switch to double-tap in “Toggle seconds gesture”.
3. Hour color: tint the hour tens digit any color; off restores the system default.
4. Floating time: long-press the status-bar time to show network time.
5. Changes are immediate; if not, restart SystemUI or the device.
